---
name: Bug report
about: Report a reproducible native port or tooling defect
title: ""
labels: bug
---

## Behavior
Expected behavior and actual result. Is this a regression? Include the commit.

## Reproduction
Commands, inputs, platform, Rust/SDL versions and relevant seed/state boundary.
Does it require private original resources or evidence fixtures?

## Evidence and validation
Distinguish DOS observation, source inference, Rust test and desktop acceptance.
Include addresses/offsets, hashes and safe text diagnostics where relevant.

## Scope and uncertainty
Known limitations, untested cases and any workaround.

Do not upload original executables/assets, manual text, raw dumps, recordings,
credentials or private data. Describe excluded fixtures by hash and local path.
